one_liner: Nifty 50 surges 1.58% amid strong FII inflows and positive global cues.

drivers.title: FII Inflows
drivers.detail: FIIs net buyers with Rs 6,836.81 Cr inflow.

drivers.title: Global Cues
drivers.detail: Positive cues from S&P 500 and Nasdaq gains.

drivers.title: Data Gaps
drivers.detail: No specific catalysts identified for broad rally.

flows_line: FIIs were net buyers with Rs 6,836.81 Cr, while DIIs sold Rs 3,678.85 Cr.
watch_next: Watch for Eurozone CPI data and COALINDIA's dividend ex-date tomorrow.
lesson_seeds: Strong FII inflows can significantly boost market sentiment.
Global market movements influence domestic indices.
Positive market breadth often accompanies index gains.
Data gaps can obscure specific market catalysts.
